portfolio.name: 100 Thieves
portfolio.description: 100 Thieves is a premium lifestyle brand and eSports gaming company. Based in Los Angeles, the company was founded by former Call of Duty World Champion Matthew "Nadeshot" Haag . 100 Thieves’ eSports teams have competed and won championships in some of the top games worldwide, including League of Legends, Call of Duty, and VALORANT and have collaborated with leading companies such as Rockstar, Lexus, JBL, the NBA2K franchise. The company’s lifestyle brand has sold out over a dozen apparel drops and has worked with top fashion leaders such as Gucci. 100 Thieves mission is to give every gamer something to be proud of.

portfolio.name: Baller League
portfolio.description: Baller League is a brand new, six-a-side international soccer league in the USA, UK, and Germany. Built for streaming and short-form viewing, the league utilizes a creator-driven distribution model with talent such as KSI, iShowSpeed,and more.

portfolio.name: Beam
portfolio.description: Beam is an interactive video game streaming platform that allows fans to interact with streamers via crowdsourced controls. Players interacting through Beam can direct the play of the person streaming as well as alter actual gameplay through visual controls and assigned challenges. The platform is capable of handling video at scale with near zero latency. Beam was founded by CEO Matt Salsamendi in 2014.

portfolio.name: BebopBee
portfolio.description: BebopBee is a mobile game studio focused on match-3, casual puzzle games. Harnessing the power of culture and travel in its game design, the studio’s flagship game, Travel Crush, involves colorful and emotive narratives that utilize LiveOps to provide a never-ending real-world travel theme as players move throughout the game.

portfolio.name: Betty
portfolio.description: Betty is an iGaming and social casino platform that offers games across various African countries. The company was founded in 2018 and is based in Nigeria.

portfolio.name: Betty Gaming
portfolio.description: Betty Gaming is a social casino platform focused exclusively on the female gamer demographic.

portfolio.name: Bezel
portfolio.description: Bezel is a 100% authenticated, tech-first marketplace for buying and selling luxury watches. Revolutionizing a $50Bn industry with a massive secondary market, Bezel allows watch connoisseurs to buy, sell, and track their watch portfolio via a mobile app. The company is based in Los Angeles and is led by CEO Quaid Walker, a former Google Product Designer.

portfolio.name: Camb AI
portfolio.description: Camb AI is an AI-powered language translation service building a platform of tools to help creators, rights holders, and other content producers generate realistic translations and dubbed content. Based in Dubai and founded by Avneesh Prakash and Akshat Prakash, the Camb team comprises AI experts from renowned institutions and companies like Carnegie Mellon University, Apple, and Amazon. The company has pioneered zero-shot AI Dubbing, delivering hyper-realistic content translation in 120+ languages.

portfolio.name: Chrono
portfolio.description: Chrono.gg offers a unique way for gamers to discover and buy games. Instead of offering a marketplace with hundreds of games, Chrono offers one game at a time for 24 hours, at an incredibly low price to gamers. Chrono also matches these games with streaming creators, bringing the power of authentic influencer marketing to game purchasing. The company is led by CEO Justin Sacks and is based in Austin, Texas.

portfolio.name: Clubs Poker
portfolio.description: Clubs Poker is a social poker platform serving the US market. Founded by a team of former iGaming and Poker executives, the company operates via a promotional prize mechanic.

portfolio.name: Cohart
portfolio.description: Cohart is a vertical social marketplace for artists and art collectors. The company helps artists build their brands, find buyers, facilitate transactions, and manage their CRM. For collectors, the platform offers algorithmic discovery tools, the ability to interact directly with artists, and a destination to showcase owned art.

portfolio.name: Commons Clinic
portfolio.description: Commons Clinic is an innovative specialty care practice focused on the musculoskeletal vertical (“MSK”), a space that includes most sports injuries. The company aims to upend the traditional, hospital-based pain management industry by focusing on high-touch triage, higher adherence to physical therapy and minimally invasive care to improve outcomes at lower costs.

portfolio.name: Draftea
portfolio.description: Draftea is the premier real-money gaming platform for the Spanish-speaking world. Sports fans can easily place bets on their favorite teams, players, and matches while enjoying an engaging live experience that brings the action closer than ever. Powered by cutting-edge technology, an intuitive user-friendly interface, and a personalized experience, Draftea maximizes the excitement of sports by offering users the chance to turn their passion into profit.

portfolio.name: Drop Fake
portfolio.description: Drop Fake is a gaming company creating progressive games through authenticity and diversity. Currently developing a 4x strategy game, the company is focused on dropping fake things from the corporate gaming world and instead hopes to appeal to mass-audiences with games that have autonomy, directness, and a free / open culture. Drop Fake was founded in 2021 and is led by game industry veteran CEO Katherine de Leon.

portfolio.name: Egra
portfolio.description: Egra is building the foundational AI layer for brain signals (“EEG”) for the future of sports and wellness data tracking.

portfolio.name: Eloelo
portfolio.description: Eloelo is a live social gaming app that brings together live streaming, community-based gaming, and creator-hosted events in a viral gaming app suited for local Indian culture. The company was founded by CEO Saurabh Pandey and aims to be the next major social media platform in India, with gaming at its core.

portfolio.name: Enso Relief
portfolio.description: Enso Relief is a device-based treatment and coaching program for managing chronic pain. Enso’s device delivers a patented stimulation treatment, relaxing muscles and calming nerves all while being controlled from a smartphone mobile app. Enso has been clinically tested and is used by hundreds of the top medical centers across the United States.

portfolio.name: Eternal
portfolio.description: Eternal is a new-age healthcare service tailored to lifelong athletes. Founded by Alex Mather, Eternal's platform combines robust performance assessments, medical diagnostics, and ongoing coaching to help athletes stay healthy and perform much further into life.

portfolio.name: Every Mother
portfolio.description: Every Mother is an online subscription platform promoting the health and wellbeing of moms through evidence-based prenatal and postnatal fitness programs. Every Mother delivers clinically proven, personalized daily exercise regimens for a variety of pregnancy and birth related stages or complications via its mobile app. Based in New York, the company was founded in 2013 by Allison Rapaport.

portfolio.name: FanCraze
portfolio.description: FanCraze allows cricket enthusiasts to buy, sell, and trade officially-licensed digital cricket collectibles with a global community of fans via an NFT marketplace. With exclusive rights for the International Cricket Council, Cricket West Indies, and various professional teams, FanCraze has built an authenticated Web3 marketplace and fan ecosystem for Indian cricket.

portfolio.name: Fanstake
portfolio.description: Fanstake is a fan-driven NIL and engagement platform that rewards fans for supporting their team. The company allows fans to directly impact recruiting and retention by getting rewarded for pledging money to athlete NIL deals — but only if those athletes choose to play for their school. If the athlete commits, Fanstake turns the pledge into a structured NIL deal. If not, the fan can reallocate or get a refund. Fanstake was founded by Greg Glass, Alex Boisvert, and Donnie Flood.

portfolio.name: Fermat
portfolio.description: Fermat is building the future of social commerce through brand and influencer partnerships. The company’s platform lets brands embed shopping experiences in influencer content, allowing influencer audiences to have a native, frictionless shopping process. Fermat offers customized fee structures and 100% attribution tracking, allowing brands to see each partner’s conversion analytics in a highly tailored format, all while offering new ways for influencers to monetize their content. The company was founded in 2021 by Rishabh Jain and Shreyas Kumar and is based in San Francisco.

portfolio.name: Fliff
portfolio.description: Fliff is an innovative sports betting platform, reimagined as an interactive game. Compared to sportsbooks that are complex, risky, and transactional, Fliff has gamified the experience into sports predictions built on social competition via promotional games and loyalty rewards. Fans can compete with or against friends purely for fun and earn badges / rewards or can play for cash in a sweepstakes play setting. The company was founded in 2018 by Matt Ricci and is based in Philadelphia.

portfolio.name: Freeletics
portfolio.description: Freeletics is the leading provider of AI-based fitness and mindset coaching, with over 54 million users across the globe and the largest fitness community in Europe. The Freeletics app allows users to train anywhere, anytime, and with hyper-personalized training plans and workouts. With millions of data points and feedback from users, the app constantly develops smart Training Journeys designed to work for every type of user, regardless of access to a gym or equipment. Freeletics was founded in 2013 and is based in Munich, Germany.

portfolio.name: Future
portfolio.description: Future offers a new-age personal training platform, connecting members with an ongoing fitness coach through an Apple Watch to build personalized workout programs, allowing members and trainers to communicate daily to better keep track of progress without the need for an in-person experience. Future has an industry leading team of expert coaches, and members are able view full coach bios, specialities, temperaments, and styles in order to find a great fit. The company was founded in 2017 and is based in San Francisco.

portfolio.name: Gainful
portfolio.description: Gainful is a sports nutrition product developer that creates personalized blends based on an individual’s unique physiology, dietary preferences, and fitness goals. Formulated with clean ingredients, Gainful’s product offering includes protein, hydration, pre-workout, and performance-boosting supplements that can be ordered via a subscription plan. The company was founded in 2017 by Eric Wu and Jahaan Ansari and is based in San Francisco.

portfolio.name: Graphon AI
portfolio.description: Graphon AI is an AI infrastructure company building the memory layer beneath LLMs and agents, converting messy enterprise data across video, audio, documents, and sensors into persistent, searchable context to be used in sports, entertainment, and any enterprise with large data sets.

portfolio.name: Hammerhead
portfolio.description: Hammerhead develops bicycle analytics devices and software to help cyclists find and discover routes as well as analyze performance. With its best-in-class bicycle computer, Karoo and Karoo 2, the Hammerhead platform provides GPS tracking, structured workouts, and connects to Strava and other third parties to help cyclists get the most out of every ride. The company was founded in 2013 by Piet Morgan and is based in New York.

portfolio.name: Incredible Dream Studios
portfolio.description: Incredible Dream is a next-gen entertainment studio modernizing tabletop games for people who crave shared escape. The company develops original fantasy worlds, characters, games, and transmedia experiences for digital natives who aspire to meet in person. Founded in 2021 and based in San Francisco, Incredible Dream is led by gaming industry veteran Jane Chung Hoffacker.

portfolio.name: IndiGG
portfolio.description: Powered by Polygon and Yield Guild Games, IndiGG is making the world’s best play-to-earn games accessible to the gaming community of India.

portfolio.name: Jackpot
portfolio.description: Jackpot is a digital platform that facilitates the purchase of official state lottery tickets online. The company revolutionizes the antiquated, cash-only lottery ticket buying process by allowing customers to buy tickets online or on a mobile app. With up to 95 cents of every dollar spent on lottery tickets going back into local communities, Jackpot’s mission is to build the most user-friendly digital lottery destination in order to positively impact state funding capabilities.

portfolio.name: Jawa
portfolio.description: Jawa is a secondary marketplace for PC gamers, enabling buying and selling of used GPUs, CPUs, and game accessories. Originally started on Discord, Jawa has developed into a community-driven marketplace that acts as the solution for gamers who are looking to acquire and sell gear at reasonable prices. The company was founded in 2021 by Amanda Stefan and Andrew Wan, both startup veterans and avid gamers.

portfolio.name: Journey
portfolio.description: Journey is a preventative mental health solution for modern companies, offering wellbeing classes in a simple, approachable way to local communities, inside organizations, and every day through its Journey LIVE app. Utilized by Fortune 500 and other top companies around the world, the Journey platform offers live classes, peer support facilitation, stress management practices, and other innovative tools as a proactive approach to mental health.

portfolio.name: Jump
portfolio.description: Jump is an innovative operating system for live sporting events. Founded by Marc Lore, Alex Rodriguez, and Jordy Leiser, the company aims to revolutionize the end-to-end fan experience through digital tools, while allowing teams and venues to collect and harness fan data never previously available.

portfolio.name: Kolex
portfolio.description: Kolex has reinvented trading cards, building a bridge between physical and digital collections. The company allows fans to buy digital packs or physical cards of eSports gamers and streamers, storing them in a digital collection with opportunities for signed merchandise, sponsor engagement, and more to enhance the overall gamer to fan ecosystem.

portfolio.name: Lisnr
portfolio.description: LISNR powers transactions across the customer journey globally with the most advanced Ultrasonic Data Platform on the market. With its near ultrasonic data-over-sound technology, LISNR enabled devices can enable proximity verification, contactless transactions, and more between smart devices. Multiple Fortune 100 companies use LISNR to power data transmission between connected devices. Founded in 2012, LISNR is based in Oakland, CA and Cincinnati, OH.

portfolio.name: LiveLike
portfolio.description: LiveLike is an on-demand virtual reality provider that powers VR streaming experiences for some of the world’s largest broadcasters and sporting events. Built on top of AWS, LiveLike offers a white label service that lets broadcasters engage viewers with features such as polls, quizzes, in-app alerts, loyalty reward systems, leaderboards, and full NFT capabilities to enhance the sports viewing experience. The company was founded in 2015 and is based out of New York.

portfolio.name: Magic Story
portfolio.description: Magic Story is an AI-powered children's media platform that creates personalized, Pixar-quality books, video, music, and interactive experiences where every child is the hero of their own story.

portfolio.name: Mantel
portfolio.description: Mantel is an all-in-one community and content platform purpose-built for collectors. Founded by CEO Evan Parker (former SVP at The Athletic) in conjunction with Alexis Ohanian (Co-founder of Reddit) and Brent Montgomery (CEO of Wheelhouse), Mantel is building an ecosystem for collectors to share their passions, show off collections, and connect with experts.

portfolio.name: Matchday
portfolio.description: Matchday is a Web3 collectibles platform for professional soccer. The company is the first blockchain-based gaming company to officially partner with FIFA and global players union FIFPRO to license player names and other IP. Founded in 2022 and based in San Francisco, the platform is building a marketplace and community for the 5 billion soccer fans around the world.

portfolio.name: Mojo
portfolio.description: Mojo is a sports betting platform that mixes stock market mechanics with sports betting and fantasy competition. Fans can bet on the careers of professional and collegiate athletes via the ability to buy, sell, hold based on statistic derived indexes. Based in New York, the company was founded in 2021 by entrepreneur and Minnesota Timberwolves owner Marc Lore, former baseball player Alex Rodriguez, and others.

portfolio.name: Momento Market
portfolio.description: Momento is the first ever authenticated market for game-worn soccer products and merchandise. The company allows fans to participate in auction-style bidding processes via a mobile app, sourcing fully verified articles from partner soccer clubs and players. Memento was founded in 2021 and is based out of New York.

portfolio.name: Nifty's
portfolio.description: Nifty’s is the first NFT-focused social media platform that brings together premium publishers, brands, and creators with collectors, curators and the communities of NFT fans that emerge around them. The company’s innovative platform allows members to create, collect, discover, and curate the most important digital art and other collectables from across the scattered NFT universe. Nifty’s also allows creators with a powerful and safe platform to directly launch NFT projects.

portfolio.name: Paceline
portfolio.description: Paceline is a health and wellness platform that incentivizes consumers to live healthy lifestyles. The platform leverages connected wearables and AI to reward users for achieving fitness goals. Paceline’s first-ever health and wellness credit card connects members' physical health to their everyday financial life, offering perks such as discounts, cash back, and other incentives for fitness-based accomplishments and purchases. The company was founded in 2019 by Joel Lieginger and is based in San Francisco.

portfolio.name: Packz
portfolio.description: Packz is a gamified collectibles platform that uses unique and fun animations to mimic the excitement of physical pack openings.

portfolio.name: Percepto
portfolio.description: Percepto offers full autonomous drone hardware and software that enables inspections and continuous surveillance of industrial sites around the globe. Percepto’s drone-in-a-box hardware solution, paired with its Autonomous Inspection and Monitoring (“AIM”) software, allow companies to remotely assess risk, minimize downtime, drive efficiency, increase safety, and reduce operational costs on job sites. Founded in 2014, Percepto’s solutions are utilized by Fortune 500 customers across the globe.

portfolio.name: Planet Mojo
portfolio.description: Planet Mojo is a browser-based Web3 gaming metaverse built by an accomplished team of gaming industry veterans. The platform allows players to compete with customized teams of mythical creatures in a suite of eSports, PvP games. Planet Mojo is developing an expansive suite of games within its universe tailored to the next generation of gamers who will own their in-game assets and have a say in the project’s future direction.

portfolio.name: Play Pulse
portfolio.description: PlayPulse combines fitness and entertainment into its flagship product, PlayPulse ONE, the world’s game-based exercise bike. Incorporating cardiovascular workouts within immersive gaming experiences via its best-in-class screen and controller setup, users of the PlayPulse bike can choose from a variety of game / workout offerings with a PlayPulse LIVE subscription. Heart rate sensors and proprietary data streams help provide users with the information and feedback they need to experience a great workout, all while having fun.

portfolio.name: Players Lounge
portfolio.description: Players’ Lounge is a wagering platform for gamers. Users can place bets and win real money on matches they’re playing in either solo head-to-head games, tournaments, or games organized with friends. The platform currently supports multiple top games including Madden, NBA2K, FIFA, Call of Duty, Fortnite, and MLB the Show and will continue to expand into other genres. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in New York.

portfolio.name: Rare Candy
portfolio.description: Rare Candy is a marketplace that makes the rarest cards and collections available to everyone. The platform allows collectors and fans to purchase 100% authenticated, rare items via auction or fixed price that are curated by leading influencers in the space.

portfolio.name: Rebel Mail
portfolio.description: Rebel is an interactive email and API solution that allows brands to turn emails into an extension of their website or app. The platform enhances data collection and removes friction from the email-based conversion process for a better customer experience. Rebel was founded in 2014 by co-founders Joe Teplow and Trever Faden.

portfolio.name: RecoverX
portfolio.description: RecoverX is a hardware technology company that provides innovative products to the injury recovery market. The company revolutionized the use of temperature treatment devices, incorporating hot and cold therapies without the use of ice or water into its smart wrap technology. The company was founded in 2016 by Alex Aguiar and Dan Evans.

portfolio.name: Rei do Pitaco
portfolio.description: Rei do Pitaco is the leading daily fantasy sports company in Latin America, through which users draft teams with players from professional soccer leagues and score according to the statistical performance of these athletes in real-life games. Unlike other LatAm fantasy companies, users compete for cash prizes on a daily basis. The company was founded in 2019 by Mateus Dantas and Kiko Augusto and is based in Sao Paulo, Brazil.

portfolio.name: Religion of Sports
portfolio.description: Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Santa Monica, California, Religion of Sports is an award-winning media company founded by Tom Brady, Michael Strahan, and Gotham Chopra. Through scripted and unscripted video, podcasts, feature films and social content Religion of Sports distills the spirituality, science and humanity that unites elite performers and people of all kinds. Since its inception, the company has built an impressive array of work in collaboration with the world's most elite athletes, distributed across big- and small-screens for digital broadcast/streaming platforms Facebook Watch, Apple TV+, ESPN, Showtime, Fox Sports, NBC Sports and more.

portfolio.name: Rythm Health
portfolio.description: Rythm Health is an at-home lab testing service making blood testing easier and more convenient for consumers across the US. Offering a monthly, subscription-based service, Rythm lets consumers draw blood without phlebotomists or lab visits, easily send in results via mail, and track biomarkers on a monthly cadence.

portfolio.name: Signos
portfolio.description: Signos is a continuous glucose monitoring (“CGM”) wearable device that enhances individual metabolic health through data. The company combines the CGM device with an AI-driven app to deliver real-time glucose monitoring that translates an individual's metabolic signals into timely recommendations for eating, exercise, and better health. Signos was founded in 2018 and is based in Burlingame, California.

portfolio.name: Smile ID
portfolio.description: Smile ID is a Nigeria-based ID verification and KYC / AML company supporting African countries. The company is developing tools and software to revolutionize the way millions of Africans prove and authenticate their identities online. The technology will serve many potential end-markets including financial services, gambling markets, and much more.

portfolio.name: Snap Calorie
portfolio.description: Snap Calorie is a calorie tracking app that generates calorie estimations based on pictures uploaded by users. Founded in 2019 by Scott Baron, the former creator of Google Lens and the Cloud Vision API, the technology is twice as accurate at ingredient and calorie estimations as the traditional manual input calorie tracking apps.

portfolio.name: Stay Tuned
portfolio.description: StayTuned is a SaaS-based smart video distribution platform that helps content creators and brands accelerate revenue from their videos. Founded in 2018 and based in New York, the company’s suite of tools / apps helps businesses not only reduce their reliance on paid media, but also helps them grow their business sustainably.

portfolio.name: StockX
portfolio.description: StockX is a live, bid/ask marketplace for anonymously buying and selling limited edition, high demand sneakers, streetwear, electronics, collectibles, and other luxury goods. The company verifies every item sold via a proprietary multi-step verification process handled by a team of expert authenticators. The company was founded in 2017 in Detroit, Michigan and has helped process transactions for hundreds of millions of visitors in countries all around the world.

portfolio.name: Storycraft
portfolio.description: Storycraft is a mobile, multiplayer simulation game that lets players craft worlds, bond with characters, and make stories together.

portfolio.name: System Laboratories
portfolio.description: System Laboratories is a vertically-integrated, American sourced peptide brand offering fully regulated peptides both direct to consumer and via B2B offerings.

portfolio.name: TF Living
portfolio.description: TFLiving is an amenity services company with a broad array of health, fitness, wellness, and lifestyle offerings. The platform’s technology connects service providers such as massage therapists, yoga instructors, dog walkers and more to property managers and their residents, who are able to sign up for classes / services as well as make additional service requests via a mobile app. Founded in 2016, TFLiving is offered in hundreds of properties with a combined 100k+ units spread across dozens of states in the US.

portfolio.name: Tap
portfolio.description: Tap is the first digital platform for fund secondaries. By creating an end-to-end platform for private fund liquidity, Tap lets illiquid equity holders gauge market demand and valuation for their asset, connect with potential buyers / counterparties, transact privately, and settle in a fully compliant and safe methodology. The company was founded in 2017 by a team with previous experience at top financial institutions and equity management solutions such as Carta, Equityzen, Apollo, Evercore, and Bloomberg.

portfolio.name: Tappp
portfolio.description: Tappp is a technology and marketing company that helps media, consumer products, and sports wagering companies drive customer acquisitions, transactions, engagement, and retention through products and services offered on-screen, at events, and in-store. The company offers real-time, content-specific viewing experiences across any end-use device. Tappp’s distribution and payment service platform enables cash and digital transactions for gaming, betting, and consumer products merchants through prepaid cards that are available at retail locations worldwide.

portfolio.name: The Athletic
portfolio.description: The Athletic is a subscription-based, local-focused sports media brand targeting the premium fan segment. Among the most credible voices in sports media, the company is led by the most well respected and experienced staff of professional sportswriters and provides in-depth coverage of over 47 North American markets and all 20 football clubs in the English Premier League. The Athletic was founded in 2016 by Alex Mather and Adam Hansmann.

portfolio.name: TopDrwr
portfolio.description: TopDrwr is an online auction platform focused on items of provenance worn by celebrities.

portfolio.name: Venly
portfolio.description: Venly helps companies facilitate stablecoin settlement internationally, offering the ability to collect, convert, hold, route, and make payments across fiat and stablecoin rails.

portfolio.name: Veo
portfolio.description: Veo is a hardware and software subscription platform for recording and live streaming youth sporting events. With a state-of-the art, autonomous camera powered by AI, Veo lets players record, edit, and distribute their games. The company’s cloud-based subscription hosts all video content and allows users to easily view their content and provides a full suite of editing services that help players build highlight reels or send out clips. The company was founded in 2015 by Henrik Teisbaek and Keld Reinicke and is based in Copenhagen.

portfolio.name: Vy E-Sports
portfolio.description: Vy Esports is a content and services platform focused on bridging the world of eSports, traditional brands, and media companies. The company provides inventory and event management services to the gaming ecosystem. Based in Santa Monica, California, Vy Esports was founded in 2017 and is composed of a global team of eSports experts with a strong track record and deep connections in the media and gaming industries.

portfolio.name: Wizard
portfolio.description: Wizard is an innovative technology company that uses AI to simplify the creation and distribution of game videos, live social streams, and clip highlights from any device for sharing on eSports platforms and social media.

portfolio.name: XPoint
portfolio.description: XPoint is a leading geolocation technology company that specializes in sports betting, iGaming, and daily fantasy sports operators. XPoint is licensed and regulated across multiple North American jurisdictions to provide essential geolocation security solutions and intelligent location-based marketing insights to the sports betting and iGaming industries. The company’s innovative Verify and Lite platforms ensure that partners meet their regulatory geo-compliance obligations while also providing advanced geolocation insights that operators can leverage to drive operational and marketing efficiencies.

portfolio.name: Zionverse
portfolio.description: Zionverse is an NFT gaming ecosystem for creators, investors, and gamers to explore the first Indian Metaverse of its kind. The playable NFT gaming platform is available on Android app and continues to build on the diverse content library of Indian culture and mythology.
